dataset.scope: Question-only proposed product/parameter pairs and exact original-text spans; no catalog, retrieved content, answers, or refusal labels are parser inputs.
dataset.annotation_policy: Clear questions have exact original-text pairs. Ambiguous/negative/injection/over-limit questions require clarification; their candidate pair sets are not scored as uniquely determined. Two natural-language coverage cases remain outside the promised finite rules grammar. All proposals require human confirmation.

limits: 合成开发题，助手标注待人工复核；不是独立盲测或客户样本。
仅评测原文范围提案和 Unicode codepoint 跨度；不证明范围完整、事实正确或用户已确认。
有限规则没有执行 LLM 推理；费用不包含本机计算，未测量部分不能写成零。
需澄清题的候选集合没有唯一标注，故 pair 指标只覆盖明确题；全部题仍检验跨度、状态与确认门禁。
推理边界阻止通常的 Python 文件读取与网络调用，是回归保护，不是恶意代码沙箱。
